summary: Iteration 15 — Authentication regression after admin password reset to 'admin123'. All 4 requested scenarios PASS end-to-end via public URL. Backend curl checks and Playwright UI checks agree: POST /api/auth/login with admin@relaispoint.fr/admin123 returns 200 + sets httpOnly cookie; GET /api/auth/me with cookie returns 200 (admin role); login with wrong password returns 401 with exact message 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect' (NOT 'Session expirée'); after successful login the modal closes, toast 'Connexion réussie' appears, and admin controls (header-add-point-btn, change-password-btn, logout-btn) are visible. Session persists after full page reload (cookie restore). Logout hides admin UI; re-login works. User's 4 custom points (Intermarche, Loker Lidl Léon Blum, Locker Super-U, Tabac du Lavoir Pirey) are intact — results-count reads '4 points relais'. No points were created or deleted during testing.

minor.issue: Response body exposes MongoDB '_id' (e.g. '_id':'6a5502e1a4db760b1fb051df'). Should exclude '_id' from serialized user payload (project only id/email/name/role). Not blocking auth but a code-quality/security hygiene item.

test_scenarios_verified.1_admin_login_success: PASS — click open-auth-btn → fill admin@relaispoint.fr/admin123 → auth-submit-btn → toast 'Connexion réussie' visible, modal closes, header-add-point-btn + change-password-btn + logout-btn all visible.
test_scenarios_verified.2_session_persistence_on_reload: PASS — page.reload() → header-add-point-btn and logout-btn still visible; results-count still '4 points relais'; /api/auth/me returns 200 (verified via curl too).
test_scenarios_verified.3_wrong_password_shows_correct_error: PASS — bad password kept modal open, body contained 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect', did NOT contain 'Session expirée'. Backend returned HTTP 401 with detail exactly that string.
test_scenarios_verified.4_logout_then_relogin: PASS — logout-btn hides admin UI and restores open-auth-btn; re-login with admin123 succeeds and admin UI reappears.

action_items: (Minor / optional) Strip MongoDB '_id' from /api/auth/login and /api/auth/me response payloads. Currently backend returns both 'id' fields but also raw '_id' string. Doesn't affect functionality but leaks internal id and violates the project guideline 'Always exclude mongodb ObjectId _id'.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth flow is solid: bcrypt verify, httpOnly cookie + Bearer fallback, samesite=none/secure — matches playbook.

AuthContext / api.js interceptor correctly excludes /auth/ endpoints from the 'Session expirée' path, so a 401 from POST /api/auth/login now surfaces as the specific 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect' toast — fix from previous iterations still holding.
Startup seed creates admin only if missing — password reset done directly in MongoDB is preserved across restarts, as intended.
Minor: /api/auth/me response still contains '_id' along with 'id'. Recommend response_model with exclude to enforce.

success_rate.backend: 100% (3/3 curl checks — login 200, /me 200, wrong-pwd 401 with correct message)

seed_data_creation: None. No points were created or deleted. The 4 user custom points remain intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is fully functional after the password reset. Testids used: open-auth-btn, auth-email-input, auth-password-input, auth-submit-btn, header-add-point-btn, change-password-btn, logout-btn, results-count. Wrong-password error message assertion string: 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect' (must NOT be 'Session expirée'). Public URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Only remaining minor is _id leakage in auth responses.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the original user complaint 'Je n'arrive pas à me connecter' was a lost/modified admin password (external to the app). Main agent reset the bcrypt hash in MongoDB to correspond to 'admin123'. Verification confirms login succeeds end-to-end, session persists via httpOnly cookie, and error path for wrong credentials returns the correct localized message without triggering the global 'Session expirée' handler.
